pf2e-kemenor-toolkit.conflict: PF2e Kemenor Toolkit: pf2e-eidolon-helper is also enabled. Both modules redirect eidolon hit point updates and will fight over them. Disable one.

sharedHP.name: Shared hit point pool
sharedHP.hint: The eidolon has no hit points of its own: it reads and writes its summoner's pool. Dying, wounded and drained are applied to the summoner.

sharedHeroPoints.name: Shared hero points
sharedHeroPoints.hint: The eidolon reads and writes its summoner's hero points.

sharedInvestiture.name: Shared investiture
sharedInvestiture.hint: Apply the summoner's invested-item benefits to the eidolon: handwraps or shared-weapon runes on its Strikes, armor potency or bands of force to AC, resilient to saves, and item bonuses to Perception and skills.

autoLink.name: Link summoners automatically
autoLink.hint: On world load, link each unlinked summoner to its eidolon when exactly one eidolon shares an owner with them. No macro, no targeting.

autoDismiss.name: Dismiss at 0 hit points
autoDismiss.hint: Remove the eidolon's tokens when the shared pool reaches 0.

delayButton.name: Delay button in the combat tracker
delayButton.hint: Show an hourglass on the active combatant to Delay, and a play arrow on a delayed combatant to return to the initiative order.

delayEffect.name: Delaying effect
delayEffect.hint: Put a Delaying effect on the actor while they are out of the initiative order, as a token-side reminder that they cannot use reactions.

delayChatCard.name: Announce Delay in chat
delayChatCard.hint: Post a free-action card when a combatant delays, returns, or lets a delay lapse.

compositionAutomation.name: Automate Lingering Composition
compositionAutomation.hint: Casting Lingering Composition rolls Performance against the standard DC for the highest-level target and arms the next composition cantrip. Casting that cantrip applies its spell effect to the caster and every ally in the emanation for the rounds earned.

manifestAction.name: Manifest Eidolon action
manifestAction.hint: Using the Manifest Eidolon action places the eidolon next to its summoner, or unmanifests it if it is already out.

createMacros.name: Macros
createMacros.label: Create macros
createMacros.hint: Add a folder of ready-made macros to this world: manifest or dismiss an eidolon, share weapon runes, pair a summoner by hand, and delay. Drag them onto a hotbar. Safe to run again to refresh them.

autoLink.ambiguous: {summoner} has {count} possible eidolons. Link one manually with game.kemenorToolkit.link(summoner, eidolon).

manifest.noEidolon: That summoner has no linked eidolon.
manifest.noToken: The summoner has no token on any scene.
manifest.already: The eidolon is already manifested on this scene.
manifest.noPermission: You do not have permission to create or delete tokens on this scene.
manifest.noActiveGM: No GM is online, so the eidolon's token can't be placed or removed.

shared.title: Share weapon runes with eidolon
shared.hint: Pick the magic weapon your eidolon's Strikes borrow runes from. It is given the invested trait and Invested for you, so it counts against your ten-item investiture limit and the inventory's own Invest toggle turns the sharing on and off. The runes only apply while you are holding it. Invested handwraps of mighty blows always take precedence.
shared.noMagicWeapons: This summoner carries no weapons with runes.

delay.effectHint: Removed from the initiative order. You can't use reactions until you return.

errors.notYourTurn: You can only Delay on your own turn.
errors.returnNeedsAnotherTurn: Returning is triggered by the end of another creature's turn.
errors.noActiveGM: No GM is online, so initiative can't be changed.
errors.queryFailed: The GM's client couldn't complete the request. See the console for details.

composition.result: {name}: the next composition will last {rounds} round(s). (DC {dc})
composition.noGM: No GM is online, so the composition effect can't be applied to allies.

link.title: Pair Summoner and Eidolon
link.hint: Choose which eidolon belongs to which summoner. This is only needed when they don't share a player owner, or when a summoner has more than one possible eidolon.
link.nothingToLink: This world has no summoners or no eidolons to pair.
